cards.name: Ash Wood Parquet English
cards.summary: Adobe Substance 3D material (Wood). Shipped preview (the material's own PNG, a lit sphere, not a script render) shows pale honey/ash-blond wood planks in staggered straight-lay parquet rows with thin dark seams, soft straight grain and a satin finish.
use_for: floor surface in 3D room or isometric interior illustrations
wooden plank sign or extruded wooden type
avoid: Dark or richly figured wood: use Larch Wood Varnished or Natural Ebony Reconstituted Wood.
Pure vector output (vinyl cutting, separations): the material renders as raster when the 3D object is expanded; use a pattern swatch fill instead.

Flat, front-on art with default lighting: expect weaker relief and highlights than on the sphere preview (the Materials effect probe barely changed flat art at defaults); inflate, extrude or rotate the art and raise the light intensity.
cards.applies_to: vector art (path, compound path, group or type) carrying a 3D and Materials live effect (Extrude & Bevel, Inflate, Revolve, Rotate or Materials)
cards.how_to_apply: Select the art, apply Effect > 3D and Materials > Extrude & Bevel / Inflate / Revolve (or Materials for flat art), then in the 3D and Materials panel's Materials tab pick 'Ash Wood Parquet English' under Adobe Substance Materials. Its properties offer the shipped presets Crown Cut, Plain Cut Glossy, Live Cut Rough. Script: the Adobe Geometry3D live effect with MaterialFilePathKey = "C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe Illustrator 2026/Support Files/Contents/Windows/Material-Resources/Default_Substance_Materials/ash_wood_parquet_english.sbsar" (panel route: app.executeMenuCommand("Live Adobe Geometry3D Materials")); this path contains spaces, which the harvest has not proved through the effect's Dict data.

verified.note: Light tan/blond wood planks in staggered rows with thin dark seams and a soft satin sheen, as described.
